statements.markdown:
**Proposition 13.3 (ordinary initial intervals).** *For every finite nonempty $F$, integer $X\ge1$, and $0<t\le1$,*
$$
\frac1X\#\{1\le N\le X:U_F(N)>t\}
 \le\frac{2}{\log(4/3)}\kappa_1(F;t).
$$
